samples.xml_description:
<module id="asyn_fifo">
    <description>Asynchronous FIFO with configurable width and depth.</description>
    <ports>
        <input id="wclk">Write clock signal.</input>
        <input id="rclk">Read clock signal.</input>
        <input id="wrstn">Write reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="rrstn">Read reset signal (active low).</input>
        <input id="winc">Write increment signal.</input>
        <input id="rinc">Read increment signal.</input>
        <input id="wdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Write data input.</input>
        <output id="wfull">Write full signal.</output>
        <output id="rempty">Read empty signal.</output>
        <output id="rdata" width_description="[WIDTH-1:0]">Read data output.</output>
    </ports>
    <parameter_description>
        <parameter id="WIDTH">8</parameter>
        <parameter id="DEPTH">16</parameter>
    </parameter_description>
    <logic_description type="sequential_logic">
        <!-- Define registers for write and read pointers -->
        <reg id="waddr_bin" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" init="0">Write pointer in binary.</reg>
        <reg id="raddr_bin" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" init="0">Read pointer in binary.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" init="0">Write pointer in Gray code.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" init="0">Read pointer in Gray code.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr_syn" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" init="0">Synchronized write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_syn" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" init="0">Synchronized read pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="wptr_buff" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" init="0">Buffer for write pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="rptr_buff" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" init="0">Buffer for read pointer.</reg>
        <reg id="RAM_MEM" width="[WIDTH-1:0]" depth="[DEPTH]" init="0">RAM memory.</reg>
        <wire id="wen" width="1">Write enable signal.</wire>
        <wire id="ren" width="1">Read enable signal.</wire>
    </logic_description>
    <implementation>
        // Convert binary pointers to Gray code
        always @(posedge wclk or posedge wrstn) begin
            if (!wrstn) begin
                wptr <= 0;
                wptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                wptr <= {wptr[WIDTH-2:0], wptr[WIDTH-1] ^ wptr[WIDTH-2]};
                wptr_buff <= wptr;
            end
        end

        always @(posedge rclk or posedge rrstn) begin
            if (!rrstn) begin
                rptr <= 0;
                rptr_buff <= 0;
            end else begin
                rptr <= {rptr[WIDTH-2:0], rptr[WIDTH-1] ^ rptr[WIDTH-2]};
                rptr_buff <= rptr;
            end
        end

        // Synchronize pointers across clocks
        always @(posedge wclk) begin
            wptr_syn <= wptr_buff;
        end

        always @(posedge rclk) begin
            rptr_syn <= rptr_buff;
        end

        // Write and read enable logic
        assign wen = winc && wrstn && !wfull;
        assign ren = rinc && rrstn && !rempty;

        // Connect RAM
        always @(posedge wclk) begin
            if (wen) begin
                RAM_MEM[waddr_bin] <= wdata;
            end
        end

        assign rdata = RAM_MEM[raddr_bin];

        // Full and empty detection
        assign wfull = (wptr_syn == {~rptr_syn[WIDTH-1], rptr_syn[WIDTH-2:0]});
        assign rempty = (rptr_syn == wptr_syn);
    </implementation>
</module>
